mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as measured by historical correlation between low rates and equity performance.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration that reduces corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly employment growth above 0.5% and housing starts decline below -0.5% signals sectoral misallocation that depresses aggregate demand confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly growth > 0.5% and HOUST monthly growth < -0.5%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 35% of instances meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for three consecutive months) increases real interest rates and reduces corporate liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns through valuation compression.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 45% of instances during tightening cycles, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive monthly industrial production growth above 0.2% indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns through near-term demand acceleration.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 50% of instances when INDPRO growth > 0.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1200 thousand units signals residential sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced aggregate demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Co-occurring inflation above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL 12m growth) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 3%) indicates delayed monetary response that increases real rate uncertainty, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 35% of instances meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (RSAFS growth above 5% for six consecutive months) signals overvaluation and reduced margin for error, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns through heightened correction risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 45% of instances during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
